headline: BTS kick off Asia-Australia leg of 'ARIRANG' tour in Kaohsiung
sub: 26 shows across 9 cities, wrapping in Australia in February

points.title: What to know
items: Stops in Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore
Jakarta, Hong Kong and Bulacan included

source: Source: BIGHIT MUSIC, Yonhap News, The Korea Times
caption:
BTS kicked off the Asia-Australia leg of their 'ARIRANG' world tour in Kaohsiung, Taiwan, on Nov 19.

This leg of 'BTS WORLD TOUR ARIRANG' covers 26 shows in 9 cities: 21 shows in 7 Asian cities and 5 in Australia. After Kaohsiung, the tour heads to Bangkok, Kuala Lumpur, Singapore, Jakarta, Hong Kong and Bulacan, then wraps up in Melbourne and Sydney in February.

📌 Source: BIGHIT MUSIC, Yonhap News (via Korean media), The Korea Times
